title: The limits of physics AI: where Siemens says the human stays in charge
summary: Siemens highlights that Physics AI can accelerate design exploration by up to 1,000x compared to traditional simulations, but the technology has firm limitations when it comes to approving safety-critical components, requiring human oversight for final sign-off decisions.
problem_solved: Addresses the gap between AI's computational speed in physics simulation and the irreplaceable need for human judgment in safety-critical engineering decisions.
why_valuable: Provides a realistic perspective on AI adoption in industrial engineering, preventing over-reliance on automation where human accountability remains essential.
